metadata.description: LLM Wiki — a Claude Code plugin for building scalable, LLM-curated personal knowledge bases.

plugins.name: llm-wiki
plugins.description: Build and maintain an LLM-curated personal knowledge base in your project. Implements Andrej Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern with sharded indexes, atomic pages, BM25 search, and a structural lint script — designed to scale to thousands of pages without becoming a context bottleneck.
